Description: Identified a Private Key, which may compromise cryptographic security and sensitive data encryption.
Author: Supersaiyane
Message:
feat: P15 the GitHub App adapter

TASK-P15-002, FEAT-091, OPEN-13. Fixes are delivered as pull requests through
a GitHub App, so Meter needs a credential that can open them without holding a
long lived token. For each request the worker signs the app's token with its
private key, read from meter/<env>/codehost/ when needed, asks GitHub which
installation holds the repository, and exchanges it for an installation token
narrowed to that repository and to what the request needs. Nothing keeps a
token and no detail carries one.

The adapter implements the four code host ports. Opening is idempotent and
never moves a branch Meter did not write; GitHub's mergeable_state becomes the
merge rule's readiness; a merge is GitHub's own at the head Meter read, so
branch protection applies and a later push merges nothing. The installation is
found rather than stored, which removes a column from TASK-P15-003.

pyjwt is admitted through make dep-check. make first-contact lists the
installation's repositories with a metadata only token, and the runbook names
the owner's steps. Nothing has met a real installation yet, ISS-300.
